limiterDetail: The main limiter is wind on the east side and current at the western grounds. Wind: Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 15.3 kt (gusts 20), Nangalao 15.0, Ciron 14.9 (gusts 20), Barangonan 14.8, Linapacan 11.6. Current now: Decabaitot 1.3 kt, Barangonan 1.2, Alava 1.1, easing to about 0.5–0.6 kt by 11 AM–noon. 9.7 kt is about 18 kph, the line fishermen treat as bad. Rain is not a factor.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR (feed issued Sat 14 5:17 AM PHT): no active gale, TCWS or heavy-rain alert matching Calamian/MIMAROPA. PAGASA alerts.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since the last digest (Sat 14, 2:20 PM)
items: Mix is now 6 GOOD / 6 MARGINAL / 4 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (was 6 GOOD / 5 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 0 VERY POOR). Still six GOOD grounds: Tara, Decabobo, Turda, Galoc, Maglalambay and Panlaitan. Coron, Culion and Alava or Binudac sit on wind 6–10 kt; Cabunlawan slipped from MARGINAL to POOR (15 kt, gusts 20). East-side wind is back at 15 kt at Decabaitot, Cabunlawan, Nangalao, Ciron and Barangonan.

Regional wind: Sun 15 7.8 kt, gusts 12; Mon 16 9.7 kt, gusts 15 (GOOD, best fishing day) ; Tue 17 11 kt, gusts 16; Wed 18 6.7 kt (calmest); Thu 19 9.4 kt, gusts 17; Fri 20 9.0 kt, gusts 22; Sat 21 9.3 kt with light rain (2.2 mm). Supply: normal to softening today, above normal Mon 16 , then normal to softening Tue–Sat. Shortage detector ELEVATED, surge OFF. PAGASA: CLEAR.

details: Galoc, Coron, Culion: wind falls to 1–3 kt from about 8 AM, current 0.1–0.4 kt after 9 AM. Tara, Decabobo, Turda: wind 0–6 kt, current 0.1–0.5 kt (Tara 0.8–1.0 kt in the evening). Panlaitan and Maglalambay: 7 kt now, easing.
